title: Portfolio Site
shortDescription: A modern full-stack developer portfolio with admin CRUD.
description: A sleek, responsive portfolio built with Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS v4, and React 19. Features an admin dashboard with full CRUD capabilities for managing projects, plus authentication and a contact form.

title: Task Manager
shortDescription: Collaborative task management with real-time updates.
description: A full-stack task management application featuring drag-and-drop boards, real-time collaboration, user authentication, and role-based access control.

title: Analytics Dashboard
shortDescription: Data visualization dashboard with interactive charts.
description: An analytics dashboard that visualizes key metrics using interactive charts and graphs. Includes data filtering, date range selection, and export functionality.

title: RESTful API
shortDescription: Secure REST API with role-based access control.
description: A production-ready RESTful API built with Node.js and Express. Features JWT authentication, role-based access control, input validation, and PostgreSQL integration.
